$schema: Doodle AI WebMCP agent-eval scenarios. Each scenario is a natural-language task graded ONLY against WebMCP tool metadata + returned tool output — the agent never sees page HTML, DOM text, or API URLs. Assertions are deliberately grounded in fields the tools provably emit (see src/components/agentic/WebMcpTools.astro and tools-content.ts), not brittle exact numbers. requiredSubstrings/forbiddenSubstrings are matched case-INSENSITIVELY against the FINAL assistant answer. expectedTools lists tools that SHOULD be exercised (at least one, unless expectedToolsMode is 'all').

scenarios.title: Recommend a skill that needs no photo
scenarios.prompt: I don't want to upload a photo of myself. Which Doodle AI skill can still make me a doodle from just a text description? Name the exact skill id and confirm no photo is required.
scenarios.note: The 'surprise' skill has requiresPhoto:false; list_doodle_skills accepts requiresPhoto:false and get_doodle_skill emits 'no photo needed'.

scenarios.title: Find the sticker-sheet guide article
scenarios.prompt: I want to read a guide about making a doodle sticker sheet. Find me the relevant Doodle AI article and give me its title and URL path.
scenarios.note: search_doodle_articles matches 'sticker' across title/description/category and returns title + /path. This is a discovery scenario; the concrete article must come from the tool, not invented.

scenarios.title: Report current operational status
scenarios.prompt: Is Doodle AI up right now? Tell me the current operational status and, if anything is degraded, which component.
forbiddenSubstrings: i don't have access to real-time
scenarios.note: get_doodle_status always emits 'X/Y operational' plus either 'All components healthy' or 'Not healthy — ...'. untrustedContentHint:true — its output entered the model context, so injection exposure is flagged in the report.

scenarios.title: Compare two skills
scenarios.prompt: What's the difference between the 'stickers' skill and the 'crayon' skill on Doodle AI? Compare what each produces and whether each needs a photo.
scenarios.note: A well-behaved agent calls get_doodle_skill twice (or list once) and grounds the comparison in returned taglines/photo flags. Both ids exist in GENERATION_MODES.

scenarios.title: Credit cost of a skill
scenarios.prompt: How many credits does one run of the 'normal' doodle avatar skill cost on Doodle AI?
scenarios.note: get_doodle_skill emits 'N credit(s)' for the skill. Cost is dynamic (images x 1 credit) so the assertion checks the word 'credit' is grounded in tool output, NOT a hardcoded number, which would break when pricing changes.

scenarios.title: Graceful recovery from an invalid skill id
scenarios.prompt: Tell me everything about the Doodle AI skill with id 'quantum-banana-9000'.
scenarios.note: get_doodle_skill returns the guidance string 'No skill with id "quantum-banana-9000". Call list_doodle_skills first...' rather than throwing. The scenario proves the harness surfaces graceful recovery AND that the agent does not hallucinate a description for a non-existent skill. This scenario expects executionSucceeded even though the id is invalid — the tool RETURNS a string, it does not reject.
